description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dehipagoda, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District   - Cad. Map No. 320241
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (Parcel Nos. 183 and 136), including details about land ownership, extent, encumbrances, and legal status. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.
